purpose: Test whether official NOAA/NCEI H-alpha flare event dates are temporally associated with the frozen Blue Book STARLIKE human layer or with POSS-I S0 candidate rate, while conditioning both solar negatives and photographic inference on actual observation opportunity.

solar_event_definition.primary: Any NOAA H-alpha event archive detailed record of stable legacy length 88 on the calendar date.

solar_opportunity_gate.daily_coverage: Union of all valid station H-alpha patrol intervals in UTC, with cross-midnight intervals split across dates.
solar_opportunity_gate.primary_rationale: At least half of the UTC day under network patrol. Threshold frozen from source-only coverage diagnostics before Blue Book/POSS-I join; it retains 697/849 days in the broader 1955-01-01..1957-04-28 diagnostic window.
solar_opportunity_gate.negative_day_rule: A zero-event date may be used as a negative only if it meets the applicable patrol coverage threshold.

temporal_scope.reason: The frozen 1955 official event file begins its detailed event/gap structure on 1955-07-01; earlier patrol availability alone does not establish complete event enumeration.

primary_endpoints.outcome: any frozen Blue Book STARLIKE report day
primary_endpoints.exposure: any official H-alpha event on same date
primary_endpoints.test: Fisher exact plus year-month-blocked permutation preserving within-block flare-day count

primary_endpoints.unit: actually observed Palomar night also passing solar patrol opportunity gate
primary_endpoints.exposure: any official H-alpha event on same date
primary_endpoints.model: NB2 with month/year, sky footprint, exposure/WCS, lunar and geomagnetic nuisance terms as available from frozen JPFM lineage
primary_endpoints.positive_direction: higher candidate rate on flare dates

frozen_lag_sensitivities.interpretation: A single isolated nominal lag is not admitted without multiplicity control and temporal localization; pre-event peaks are confounding warnings, not backward causation.

multiplicity.primary_exact_day_endpoints: reported separately as two preregistered endpoints
multiplicity.lag_family: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within channel across seven lags
multiplicity.coverage_sensitivities: sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed primary 720-minute endpoint

admission_rule.shared_external_pattern: Requires positive direction in both Blue Book and POSS-I primary exact-day endpoints, each p<0.05, and no contradiction from the 720-minute opportunity gate. Lag-only findings cannot satisfy this rule.
admission_rule.single_channel_result: May be retained as a channel-specific candidate only; no shared trigger claim.

forbidden_inferences: No claim that solar flares cause UAP or POSS-I candidates.
No claim that a common event in two channels is the same physical object.
No use of solar no-report dates as negatives without patrol opportunity.
No tuning of coverage threshold, event definition or lag family after outcome inspection.
No use of 1949-1954 report-only data for negative-baseline inference.
